name: sidebar
summary: The product's PRIMARY navigation — the left vertical MODULE rail (FlotoNavBar). Collapsed to 65px (brand mark + module icons) by default; HOVER-expands to 170px (ObserveOps wordmark + labels), or pin it open with `expanded`. Data-driven module list (icon + label, optional BETA tag); the active module highlights --primary-alt on --nav-selected-text-color, a hovered non-active item gets a --nav-hover-bg pill. Theme-aware. Pairs with obs-app-header (the horizontal top bar). NOT an in-module section menu (side-menu) and NOT sibling-view switching (obs-tabs).

variants.name: collapsed
variants.what: 65px icon-only rail (default) — brand mark + module icons

variants.name: expanded
variants.what: 170px — hover-expands (or `expanded` pins it): ObserveOps wordmark + module labels

variants.name: active-item
variants.what: the current module highlighted --primary-alt on --nav-selected-text-color, radius 6px (aria-current)

variants.name: with-beta
variants.what: a module carrying a BETA tag (e.g. SLO)

states.name: hover-item
states.what: a non-active item shows a --nav-hover-bg pill

states.name: active
states.what: the current module: --primary-alt background, --nav-selected-text-color text, 6px radius

items.note: the module list — a JSON array of {key,label,icon,beta?}. `icon` is an obs-icon name (the product module glyph); `beta:true` adds a BETA tag. For the ObserveOps rail, DO NOT guess icons — copy the canonical 16-module mapping from this registry's `productModules.items` (verified against the product; e.g. Topology = "topology", not "networkTopology").

brand.note: the wordmark text shown when expanded (or use the `brand` slot for a logo image).

expanded.note: pin the rail open at 170px; otherwise it hover-expands and collapses.

events.navigate: ({key,label}) — a module was clicked (wire it to your router: push the module route).

slots.brand: OPTIONAL wordmark text shown when expanded (default: ObserveOps). Only change it when the user explicitly asks for a different brand name.
slots.logo: OPTIONAL override for the mark. By DEFAULT the sidebar already renders the built-in ObserveOps / Motadata brand mark — do NOT fill this slot unless the user explicitly wants a different logo.

decisionFlow: Switch between top-level product MODULES (Dashboards / Monitors / Alerts / …)? -> obs-sidebar (the left module rail).
Navigate SECTIONS within one module (e.g. Settings sub-nav)? -> a side-menu, NOT the sidebar.
Switch between sibling VIEWS of the SAME page? -> obs-tabs.
Show location + a way up a hierarchy? -> obs-breadcrumbs.
The horizontal global bar (logo / search / notifications / user)? -> obs-app-header (the sidebar's top-bar counterpart).
A step-through create/setup flow? -> a stepper (steps), not the sidebar.

collapsed.useWhen: the default resting rail — maximise content width; icons carry the modules, labels appear on hover
collapsed.dontUse: when labels must always be visible (pin it with `expanded`)
collapsed.example: the 65px ObserveOps rail on a Monitors list page

expanded.useWhen: labels should stay visible (wider viewports, onboarding) — set `expanded` to pin 170px
expanded.dontUse: on narrow layouts where content width matters (leave it collapsed / hover-expand)
expanded.example: the pinned 170px rail showing Dashboards · Monitors · Alerts · …

active-item.useWhen: always — set `active` to the current module key so the rail reflects the route
active-item.dontUse: never leave `active` unset on a real page (the rail should always show where you are)
active-item.example: active="inventory" highlights Monitors as a --primary-alt pill

with-beta.useWhen: a module is in beta — add beta:true to its item

logo.useWhen: the user has EXPLICITLY asked to show a different brand — then override slot="logo" with their image and set the brand wordmark to their name.
logo.dontUse: by default. The sidebar ships with the ObserveOps / Motadata brand mark built in; an AI tool must NOT replace, remove, or blank it unless the user explicitly requests a custom logo.
logo.must: keep the default ObserveOps brand logo unless the user asks to swap it.
logo.example: default (no slot) → the built-in Motadata donut mark. Custom brand only on request: .

do: Keep the default ObserveOps / Motadata brand logo — it ships built-in. Only override slot="logo" (and `brand`) when the user EXPLICITLY asks for a different logo.
Feed the role/license-gated module set via `items`; set `active` to the current route's module key.
Pair it with obs-app-header (the horizontal top bar) for the full app chrome.
Let it hover-expand by default; only pin `expanded` when labels must always show.
Reuse the module glyphs from the product icon library (obs-icon names).
dont: Don’t replace, remove, or blank the default logo — the sidebar comes with the ObserveOps brand mark by default; swap it only on explicit user request.
Don't use it for in-module section navigation (that's a side-menu) or sibling views (obs-tabs).
Don't hand-roll a module rail — reuse obs-sidebar.
Don't hardcode the panel colours — they're theme tokens (--nav-panel-bg / --nav-text-color).
Don't leave `active` unset on a real page.

a11y.summary: A <nav aria-label="Primary"> landmark; each module is a link with aria-current="page" on the active one. Labels are visually hidden when collapsed but the link text remains in the accessibility tree (icons are decorative). Keyboard: links are tabbable and activate on Enter.

issues.issue: SF-001 — a visible focus ring on nav items should be verified against the --nav-panel-bg / --nav-hover-bg surfaces in both themes.
The rail hover-expands on pointer hover; keyboard/touch users rely on the collapsed icons (labels stay in the a11y tree) — pin `expanded` where always-on labels matter.

knownIssues.issue: obs-sidebar is a render-faithful reproduction of the primary nav (FlotoNavBar). The real rail is router/store-bound and permission/role-gated (visibleMenuItems); wiring `navigate` to the router, the active-route binding, and the module gating are the consumer's.

changelog.change: Published the canonical module→icon mapping (productModules.items) — all 16 ObserveOps modules with their real key/label/icon, verified against the product navbar + render-checked, so the rail is built by copy not by guess (G23). Fixes the ambiguity that let Topology ship as networkTopology (a switch) instead of topology (a node tree).

Decorative mask-group blobs now render the real product SVG (two gradient circles, green→blue + yellow→orange) at opacity 0.5 per circle so the overlap composites like the product; exact product colors; position right:-75 / bottom:-90 / 200×200.

changelog: 2026-08-12 — Decorative bottom mark (owner): replaced the CSS-gradient blobs with the real product "Mask Group" SVG — a green→blue circle + a yellow→orange circle at the bottom-right (right:-75/bottom:-100/200×200, matching the product), clipped by the rail. Stop colours are DS tokens (--secondary-green/--primary/--secondary-yellow/--secondary-orange), so it is theme-aware and hardcode-free.

2026-08-12 — Sidebar tuning (owner): module icons 22→21.5px; removed the logo mark row bottom margin (was 8px); the rail is now 64px content + a 1px right border (--border-color) = 65px total footprint (crisp divider). Also: obs-icon now accepts decimal sizes (e.g. 21.5).

2026-08-12 — Product-match sizing (owner): logo mark 26→30px (product img is 30×30), module icons 18→22px, and the inter-item vertical gap 8→4px (tighter stack, matching the product; left/right inset unchanged). Logo + icons stay centre-aligned on the same axis.

2026-08-06 — Logo guidance (owner): the sidebar ships with the ObserveOps / Motadata brand mark by DEFAULT and AI tools must NOT replace or blank it unless the user explicitly asks. Reframed slots.logo / slots.brand as OPTIONAL overrides, added a `logo` usageRule + do/dont so generated sidebars keep our brand.

2026-08-06 — Behaviour + shadow fix (owner): (1) hover/pin expansion now OVERLAYS the page — the host reserves only the 65px rail in the layout and the panel widens on top (z-index) instead of pushing/squeezing the content beside it. (2) Softened the drop shadow (2px 0 8px, lower-alpha var(--nav-shadow-color, rgba(70,70,70,0.08))) — the old 3px 10px 10px rgba(70,70,70,0.15) read too dark.

2026-07-26 — Fix (owner): softened the decorative bottom blobs to match the product — removed the --primary (blue) mix that made the green read murky/dark, made them solid-cored pastel green + amber, and added a blur so they are soft/diffuse (not hard-edged circles with a straight bottom clip).
2026-07-26 — Docs accuracy pass (owner): synced tokensUsed to the tokens the element actually resolves. Reuse (obs-* composition) / props / variants / a11y verified current — no drift. No API change.

2026-07-21 — Icon-reuse cleanup (surfaced once obs-sidebar was added to the elements-api MAP → guards scanned it): the default logo mark now composes <obs-logo name="motadata"> instead of a hand-drawn donut <svg>; the decorative corner blobs are CSS radial-gradients on brand tokens (--secondary-green/--primary/--secondary-yellow/--secondary-orange) instead of an inlined gradient <svg>; the rail box-shadow uses var(--neutral-shadow-light) instead of a raw rgba. No visual/behaviour change intended. Structural guard + full deploy preflight now clean.

changelog.change: Fidelity pass (owner review vs product): the logo mark is smaller (26px) and centred on the SAME vertical axis as the module icons; the ObserveOps wordmark is normal weight (was 600) at 13px (was 15px); added the panel drop-shadow (box-shadow 3px 10px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)) in both modes; and the decorative blobs now sit BEHIND the menu items (z-index) instead of over them.

Pixel-matched to the product (nav.less + navbar.vue): ACTIVE pill is now --primary-alt on --nav-selected-text-color (was --primary/--nav-panel-bg), radius 6px (was 8px), item height 40px / padding-left 17px expanded (centred collapsed), logo row 53px (header-height − 2). Added the decorative mask-group blobs (green-blue + yellow-orange) bottom-right, and a `logo` slot using the real Motadata donut mark (brand-logo.png). Showcase now lists all 16 real modules.

Added obs-sidebar — the primary module rail (FlotoNavBar): collapsed 65px icon rail hover-expanding to 170px (or pinned via `expanded`), data-driven `items` [{key,label,icon,beta?}], `active` module highlighted --primary (aria-current), BETA tags, brand mark + wordmark (or brand slot). Emits `navigate`. Composes obs-icon for module glyphs. Source-derived from the rendered Navigation/PrimaryNav story + layout/navbar.vue (nav is router/store-bound). Pairs with obs-app-header.

productModules.$note: The CANONICAL ObserveOps module rail — all 16 product modules with their REAL key/label/icon, extracted and verified against the product navbar (src/components/layout/navbar.vue) and render-checked. COPY these straight into obs-sidebar `items` to build the product-faithful rail — do NOT pick icons by eye from the 553-glyph library. Trap example: Topology is icon "topology" (a hierarchical node tree), NOT "networkTopology" (a network switch/hub) — both exist and both are plausible from the name alone. Set `active` to the current module key.
